lines.text: A special event has occurred.
Participate in the event.
Go back.
I make my way to the walking trail for the Snowfield Festival that Ludmilla and Mica have prepared.
The festival is already underway, and there are several red lanterns floating in the sky.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Did you come to set off a lantern, Commander?
Yes, are you here to do the same?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: You see that?
Delta points to a lantern floating not too far off in the distance.
Yours, I presume?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Yes. Along with Signal.
So you both made a wish?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Signal wished for

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: the Scouts' missions next year to be a success,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: and also wished for your happiness.
For my happiness? I appreciate that.
Where is Signal?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: She scurried off

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: once she saw you approaching.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I was actually in the midst of trying to find her.
I see... do you want me to help you look for her?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: It's okay. You have to set off a lantern.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Ludmilla and Mica are handing out lanterns further along the trail.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: You go ahead. I can look for Signal myself.
Okay.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: See you later.
Delta gives me a salute before heading out.
She really seems to be enjoying this.
The trail extends ahead of me.
I proceed further along but suddenly hear noises up ahead, which sound like an altercation.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: No, I don't want to.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: C'mon Eunhwa, don't be like that.
Did you both come to set off lanterns as well?

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: C-Commander!?

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Well, we were told that if we release a lantern, nothing bad will happen to us next year, so...

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: And I keep telling her that

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: it's absurd for Absolute to rely on such childish superstitions.
Hold that thought for just a second.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: What are you planning...
I take the other end of the lantern which Vesti is holding, hand it to Eunhwa,
and light it.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: You fool...!
Taken aback, Eunhwa lets go of the lantern.
Vesti cheerfully releases her grip on the lantern as well, sending it soaring into the sky.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: May next year be filled with happiness.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Thanks for helping, Eunhwa.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... Where is Emma when you need her?

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: She said she'd be back after cleaning the restaurant.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Later we can watch the lanterns together with her.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: By the way, thank you as well, Commander.
Vesti and I wave to each other as I turn and head back onto the walking trail.
A little further along, I run into Ludmilla and Mica, who are giving out lanterns to others.
Beside them are Emma, Blanc, and Noir.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Commander!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Pit Boss!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Hello...

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Are you going to set off a lantern too, Old-Timer? Wait just a moment...

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: ... Uh-oh.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: What's wrong, Mica?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: There are only four lanterns left.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Oh my... so we're short by two?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Looks like it...

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Blanc and I can share one.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Yeah, I'd like that a lot!

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Thank you. Now that still leaves us one short...
I'm okay. You all go ahead and take a lantern.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Don't even start with that.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: You're a guest here at Snowfield.
Honestly. Watching you all release the lanterns will be more than enough for me.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: All right, if that's how it's going to be, then this is how we can do it.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: You can choose someone here to release a lantern together.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Yeah, let's do that. You've gotta bring in the new year right, after all.
If you say so...
Join Blanc and Noir.
Join Emma.
Join Mica.
Join Ludmilla.
I decide to release a lantern together with Blanc and Noir.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I can't believe the year is almost over already...
You said we should try and transfer all the bad energy we've built up over this past year into the lantern, right?
Do either of you remember any bad things that happened this year?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Nope! I was pretty much always happy since I had you and Noir.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I can't think of anything either.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: It was really a happy year.
I'm glad you both feel that way.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Maybe we should write a wish on the lantern.
Come again?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: You know, instead of all that stuff to do with releasing bad energy, we can just write a wish.
Let's do that. What should we write?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: May next year be filled with as much luck as this year.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: That's not too basic, is it?
Not at all.
It's a wonderful wish.
Noir takes out a pen and writes down the wish.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Okay, let's release this little fella.
Together, we release the lantern high in the air.
As it ascends into the sky, our lantern lights up the area around Snowfield Hot Spring.
I decide to release a lantern together with Emma.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: You want to release a lantern with me, Commander?
I nod.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Oh my...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I'm honored!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: So,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: did you have any bad experiences this year?
Hmm...
Not really.
I'm just glad that I got to spend so much time with all of you.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Hehe, I see.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Then... Maybe we should wish that we can spend more time with each other next year.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: You just have to promise that you won't overexert yourself in the process, okay?
... I'll try.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I'll be keeping an eye on you,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: so no lying to me, okay?
Okay.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Hehe, all right then.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I hope the next year will be a peaceful one.
With a smile, Emma releases the lantern towards the sky.
As it ascends into the sky, our lantern lights up the area around Snowfield Hot Spring.
I decide to release a lantern together with Mica.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: So, should we try and transfer all this year's bad energy into the lantern?
Let's.
Mica closes her eyes and begins to murmur.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: May all this bad energy be carried away.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I hope Belorta and I will continue to get along next year,

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: and I hope there will come a day when I can repay Old-Timer for everything he's done for me.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: That's all for me.
My turn, then?
May next year be a happy one.
May Mica and Belorta continue to get along next year,
and may I help Mica in every way I possibly can.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Old-Timer!
I'm also done with my wish.
Ready to release the lantern?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Yes!
Mica and I release the lantern high towards the sky.
As it ascends into the sky, our lantern lights up the area around Snowfield Hot Spring.
I decide to release a lantern together with Ludmilla.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Everyone seems quite happy.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I'd say organizing this festival was a grand idea.
True to Ludmilla's statement, everyone has big smiles on their faces as they release their lanterns.
You're right.
What about you, Ludmilla?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Me?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: If you're able to rest and have a good time here at Snowfield, that's good enough for me.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: My role is to help you enjoy your time here as much as possible.
Everyone here is having a wonderful time, thanks to you.
You always make sure everything is in working order in the mornings,
and you organized this festival.
However,
you also deserve to enjoy your own vacation here at the hot spring.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Maybe you're right.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: But you really needn't worry about me.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I'm truly having a great time, thanks to you being here.
As Ludmilla speaks, she breaks out into a bright smile.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Now, should we release our lantern?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: It was wonderful getting to spend time with you.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I hope that next year I can continue to do the same.
Ludmilla gently releases the lantern.
As it ascends into the sky, our lantern lights up the area around Snowfield Hot Spring.
After everyone has released their lanterns, I'm walking around the area, when Mica calls out to me.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Old-Timer, come with us to see the lanterns.
Can't we see them here?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Sure, but there's a great viewing spot I found.
Ludmilla guides us to a bridge near the hot spring.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Right here.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Wow! It's gorgeous.
Specks of red light fill the night sky,
like bunches of hearts gathering together, illuminating the darkness.
It's hard not to be moved by the sheer beauty of it all.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Hey, Old-Timer...
Mica gently taps me on the shoulder and points to the center of the bridge,
revealing a lantern which has been abandoned.
What's a lantern doing here?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: At any rate, we shouldn't leave it here. We might as well release it.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Shall we?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: The only thing is that we already released all our bad energy before,

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: and we already made a wish too...
Then...
Why don't we make a wish for everyone?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: That's not a bad idea.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I like it!
Ludmilla and Mica each grab ahold of the lantern and make a wish
before gently releasing it and letting it slowly rise into the air.
As I gaze at the lantern, I silently make a wish once again.
May a happy year come to all of us.
As it ascends into the sky, our lantern lights up the area around Snowfield Hot Spring.
Snowfield Lighthouse: END
In time, the lanterns that lit up the night sky slowly went out, one by one.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Has everyone gone back?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I'm the only one left.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: May next year be a happy year for everyone...
At that moment, a gentle breeze sweeps through Ludmilla's hair,
revealing her faint smile.
However, her enjoyment of having a moment to herself was short-lived.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Hmmm?
She sees someone approaching with one hand behind their back.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: You are...

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... Lumi.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Do you need anything?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Did you come here looking for that abandoned lantern?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I wanted you to enjoy the Snowfield Festival too.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Lumi, I don't know what happened to you, but...
At that moment.

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: Ahah...!
Lumi screams while looking up at the sky.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Lumi...!?

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: Sister...

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: Sister...

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... Help me.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Lumi, what did you say...
Lumi slumps on the ground, repeatedly uttering the same words.

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... Help me.

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... Help me.

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... Help me.
In Lumi's frightened eyes,
the red lights in the sky are reflected.
